Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


6.4. Combat

Combat results when a minion blocks the action of a ready minion.
Also, some cards' effects may cause combat. Whatever caused the
combat, it is important to remember that only ready minions can
participate in combat and that your minions cannot enter combat with
any of your other minions.
